candidates.change_summary: Change the returned boolean from true to false so transfer always returns false after performing calls.
Return the success status of the last low-level call instead of true, making the function's return reflect call outcome.
Return true only if all low-level calls succeed; otherwise return false (aggregating success), instead of always true.

Change the calldata selector to call transfer(address,address,uint256) instead of transferFrom, altering which external function on caddress is invoked and thus potentially changing external state observed via transfer.
Remove the call to caddress entirely so no external calls are made, altering any external-state side effects that would have been visible through transfer.
Make the call use call{value: 1 wei}(...), forwarding 1 wei to caddress which can change observable behavior if external contract reacts to received ETH.
Change the loop bound to i< _tos.length - 1 so the last recipient is not called, altering observable external effects of transfer.

Replace the low-level call with a Solidity external call style assuming caddress implements a function transferFrom, which changes call semantics and may revert differently, altering observable behavior.
